title: [Shopify] Fix GraphQL rate limiter under-waiting after elapsed time
summary: The Shopify connector's GraphQL rate limiter was waiting incorrectly when time had elapsed between requests, causing it to re-issue requests too early into the throttle window. The fix anchors the wake time to the current moment plus remaining wait time instead of incorrectly subtracting the elapsed gap twice.
key_points: Rate limiter waited too short when time had passed since the last Shopify response, which caused avoidable GraphQL throttling on high-volume shops
The wait time already accounts for elapsed time, but anchoring it at LastRequestedOn subtracted that elapsed gap a second time
Wake time is now anchored at CurrentDateTime plus the remaining wait
Removed the redundant earlier NextRequestAfter := CurrentDateTime assignment
Added a test that checks the limiter waits for the remaining time after some time has elapsed
